value.rationale: The 2024 source specifically calls orientation-only resetting under confinement an unstudied physically motivated protocol. A full analytic sign classification of stationary position skewness directly quantifies whether directional resets induce non-Gaussian equilibrium-shape asymmetry in the trap. The strict sign for all trap and reset strengths, with nontrivial rational dependence and independence from additive thermal diffusivity, is more than a finite parameter numerical check or a renaming of a free result. The claim does not require a paper-sized downstream theorem and does not imply distributional symmetry is controlled by covariance.
